meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed live role policy, model loop, selected tools, instruction files, conversation evidence, outage behavior and generated contract; no free-form local answer bypass.

auth.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and session authorization; existing server actor ownership and CSRF remain enforced, no auth implementation changes.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed backend skill and commerce data contracts; read-only model-selected facts do not change payment, order, catalogue or checkout writes.

content.review_note: Reviewed browser snapshot bounds, per-owner and page key, revision conflict, explicit save token cleanup and unchanged MySQL CAS and publication status.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed role access, runtime files, shared services, JSON conversation persistence and public route contracts; no installation/storage migration.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed AdminController diff: no Google reporting, integrations or tag behavior changed.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed shared request failure docs and backend skill; unavailable inference is an explicit saved agent error; HTTP boundary handler unchanged.

interface.review_note: Reviewed native chat model-selected form and reference cards, error retry identity, preserved explicit forms and browser-safety contract.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController and SupportController changes; model form proposal never submits or queues mail; existing mail routes and abuse containment unchanged.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed shared audit categories and transport metadata; no change to MCP client scopes, authentication, or CLI protocol.

media.review_note: Reviewed upload eligibility, revision hash, bounded UTF-8 metadata, row lock, exact patch, no row creation, and view/search/isolated DB tests.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed both native chat entrypoints and unchanged Help, account and form routes; ordinary questions model-selected, explicit commands remain UI operations.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed shared PublicKnowledgeService and presentation projections; new article body and actor-specific tools remain native-only; public MCP schemas and access unchanged.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed controller and public projection changes; cart/order tools are read-only and existing remote cart, checkout and payment contracts are unchanged.

sales-channels.review_note: Reviewed MediaService metadata/search patch; URL, binary and usage fields used by published feeds remain unchanged.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed model-first binding AGENTS rule and CI loopback gate, regenerated maps and contracts; no deployment workflow or credentials changed.
